headline: A syndicated travel article says AI chatbots have given travellers bad advice, from 'bogus bars' to visa mistakes.
score_reason: Pool score 1 kept: headline only, so no extra weight can be given.
importance_line: Travellers who rely on chatbots for trip plans could be given wrong advice, but which cases are meant and how common they are is not known.
summary: The Wichita Eagle runs a syndicated travel article reporting that AI chatbots have given travellers poor advice, from 'bogus bars' to visa problems.
